reviews.text: I have recently moved to LA and was searching high and low for a good vet for my 9-year-old husky, Shadow, and I found a fabulous vet instead. We had our first visit just now. The Value Vet team are a beautiful team and Dr Werber is a man with a golden heart. I can’t recommend them enough. Thank you Value Vet Inc

Dr. Werber is very nice and personable, but the front office staff are truly the Achilles heel of this practice. When my dog’s lab results came back with a high white blood cell count (which indicates infection), I thought surely someone would contact me with a prescription for antibiotics. Even after multiple attempts to follow up, nothing. No response to my requests to treat my dog’s infection, no response to have the labs/x-ray that was taken sent to me.

During the vet exam, Dr. Werber did not even bother to use his stethoscope to listen to my senior dog’s heart and lungs. Cardiopulmonary assessment and treating abnormal lab results - especially ones indicative of infection - are the cornerstones of internal medicine. This is absolutely unacceptable.

I ended up taking my dog to a different vet within the same week and paying for a second exam just to get my dog on some antibiotics for his infection. Turns out, he has pneumonia.  Untreated infections turn into sepsis, sepsis turns into septic shock, septic shock turns into death or at the very least, an expensive inpatient stay. I will not be returning. My dogs deserve better.
Poor costumer service, they not answering the phone when you need them

I’d heard many positive comments about Value Vet and Dr. Werber.  Breezy had a retained and inflamed baby tooth that needed extraction.  With our local vet practice and so many others being bought out by greedy corporations it was difficult to find a private practice that was affordable, especially for dental care. Value Vet checked all the boxes - affordable prices, clean facility, caring personnel and highly rated veterinarians. Dr. Werber was so kind and gentle with Breezy - she was scared but he quickly put my trembling little girl at ease. From the moment we arrived in the morning to picking her up later, the front office staff were exceptionally warm and welcoming, helpful and considerate. A very heartfelt thank you to Dr. Werber and his wonderful team.

I’ve been coming here on and off since my dog was 2-3 years old and now he’s 11 and I only come here. Dr. Leslie Davidson is really great and I’m thankful for the team’s quick responses to my emails (more efficient than phone imo plus then there’s a record for convenience). My dog is healthy thanks to the affordable cost of good care.

Love this Vet, staff is amazing and Vet Techs are very empathetic , knowledgeable and efficient.

Being a college student and now Post-grad this vet has always made this process tremendously easier and comfortable
Very nice caring people very knowledgeable

Our dog, George, got a bee sting on his paw in the park, not being around from here, visiting my family from the Modesto area,  I was panicky and my daughter and I asked complete strangers wher to take our dog, not knowing if he would get a bad reaction from this sting, I  was told, the best place is Value Vet. Once there it was fast and quick and they took the stinger out, gave him his meds, and he is a new dog now, after sleeping for several hours , resting and relaxing with us. Thank you for giving him comfort and kindness to our sweet ittle baby.  Appreciate it, and if anything happens in the future, we will ONLY GO THERE! The best vets and front staff, as service is Plus -plus!! Thank you!
I can’t speak for the Doctors however i called the office and the lady on the phone was extremely rude and abrupt and hung up on me mid sentence while I was asking about the cost of their services

I have been going to Value Vet for my dog for 12 years. I go to Dr.Davidson, who is fabulous. Also Rose, one of the technicians goes above and beyond anything I’ve ever seen. They truly love animals and don’t try to rob you.
Dr Werber is terrific!

I took my 6months old cat for a walk in rabies vaccination here today. She was refused by vetco bc of hissing the doctor. But ValueVet managed to take care of her and do the vaccination in 3 minutes. The whole process (from walk in to check out)only takes me about 10minutes. Staffs and veterinarians are super friendly and professional. $39 for 1 rabies shot. Fair price.  Def recommend taking ur pets for vets here!

* UPDATE 01/27/26 - unfortunately I needed to take another star off of my rating for Value Vet. This has nothing to do with Dr Davidson. But the office has really changed. It is no longer a value and I don't believe anyone working there gets that. Prices have gone up 3x what they used to be. They also don't tell you what things are going to cost. You just get hit with an astronomical bill at the end of the service. I also had a very unfortunate issue a few months back. They must be hiring young unskilled or very novice vet assistants. One of them wrapped my dog's tail too tight after he had a growth removed. It became necrotic and the dead part needed to be cut off. Dr Davidson took full responsibility for what happened and I was refunded everything and given a credit for the future. But the oversight was not there. Thank God I knew that this was an emergency and got him back to the office pronto or it could have been much worse. I'm quite sad as I really love Dr Davidson but I cannot really afford "Value Vet" anymore. My dog is now almost 17 and I need to have a few things looked after and I am trying to find someplace to go with good care and reasonable pricing for normal people. I will even drive much further afield to find this as Value Vet will only be a last resort for us now. --Took off one star from my original review as, since the new office and new vet Dr Werber is there, it can be rather chaotic. Dr Werber has a kind of Hollywood following 🤷🏻‍♀️. Hence there can be some interesting personalities in the waiting area now. This has nothing to do with Dr Davidson as he is still wonderful. But the prices have gone up. Probably to pay for the expansion and renovation! But we will never stop going to Dr D. We love him. And he is conservative with tests et. He tries to keep prices reasonable when you are on a budget.  Value Vet Westwood is, hands down, the best vet establishment I have ever visited in LA. Dr Davidson has been our vet for about 3 years now. He is kind, compassionate, funny, honest and will never over prescribe tests or medication. He takes a conservative approach and understands that vet bills add up. He would never order a test he didn't think was absolutely necessary. But the quality of care my dog gets is A+++. Just this past weekend I got to meet his associate Dr Hall as Dr D was away on vacation and my dog hurt his back. Dr. Hall is amazing as well. When I questioned whether my dog should have a baseline x ray she told me it was not necessary because she could tell what was going on from palpating his body. When I asked if a steroid shot, in addition to meds, would help she told me just to administer meds as soon as we got home and keep him resting. My dog was up and walking close to completely normally in 12 hours!!! I'm amazed by Value Vet. The staff is also wonderful and obviously loves animals. It isn't a fancy place. You will need to show up early and possibly return after lunch for your appointment. The one exam room is the size of walk in closet. And I love all of it because the quality of care is what matters. There are tons of fancy vet offices with cushy waiting rooms but you are paying for all that when they tack on lots of tests and high priced products you don't really need. Take it from someone who has been a volunteer in animal rescue for 20+ years Value Vet is a rare authentic find. Pro Tip, do call if you aren't showing up first thing in the morning to line up. If the doctor has operations in the afternoon they may not be taking patients and if the morning was busy there may be no afternoon appointments left. Best to be there first thing in the morning if the issue is urgent.

Value vet not so value
Done X-ray on my puppy without informing me,
nor letting me know how much
Then charged me $400!
Fraud do not go!
Not recommended at all!
There’s better places that cleaner and nicer
And actually answer the phone
Dr Werber is wonderful when you can meet him, but you and your dying animal are nothing but a number in the waiting room.
Great friendly people!!

DO NOT TRUST THE STAFF HERE!  I spend more than a thousand dollars combined for international travel documents. It turns out the health certificate was filled wrong, so USDA rejected it. Now I have to wait another 10 days. I am forced to book new flights just to accommodate their mistake,  and the flight price are doubled. How is it possible that you charge $400 for a one-page form and still manage to screw it ??

Saw Dr. Werber today for the first time. Such a great experience! Between the staff, check in and time with the Dr., we’re wouldn’t take our dog anywhere else ever again. If you’re looking for a vet, consider yourself lucky if you can get an appointment here!!
Great experience with Dr Nitzan for my little dog harry - would come back again if needed
I have a great experience. I highly recommend it.

Dr. Werber is the best. I've trusted him with all my dogs. This my now my 3rd and I've been bringing my dogs to him for 20 years.  There's no other vet I would bring my dogs to. He truly cares about the animals, and takes the time to listen to your questions and concerns.

Went here for three years and it kept getting worse so I had to leave— they’re super disorganized, never answer the phone or emails, and make you wait 1-2 hours even with an appointment. Save yourself the headache

Dr. Werber is the kindest, most genuine vet that I've ever met. Additionally - he actually LISTENS and responds. If you leave him a message, he calls you back. He doesn't rush you through the call. I am truly grateful for his help. If you have ever watched one of his videos, he seems super friendly and actually excited about the work he does - and that's exactly how he is in person.
We will follow Dr. Werber anywhere. He has cared for all of our pets with compassion and kindness.

NEVER coming back.
I arrived after speaking with Carmel, who told me the clinic was hers.needless to say, it’s not her clinic.
The person at the front wasn’t very nice, and I had to fill out all the paperwork again although I filled it prior to the visit. He also told me the papers I need will take up to 8 weeks although Carmel told me up to 6 weeks… which is crucial for my traveling situation.
I checked in, and waited 65 minutes. All the people who arrived after me- entered.
I asked twice and I was told to wait. On my third asking, a nice lady finally told me I didn’t have an appointment and I was considered as walk-in, although I spoke with Carmel the day before to schedule and drove 1 hour so I was definitely not a walk in. The lady also told me the doctor won’t see me in the next 15 minutes which will make the total waiting time 80 minutes. I left, nobody cared or even said sorry, and I texted Carmel who did not take responsibility and basically said she can’t take responsibility because I arrived on a day she wasn’t there. She also educated me and told me it’s ok to wait for the vet, and that she never said the clinic was hers (I have it in a voice message…). Only after answering her again and telling her their customer service sucks she typed “sorry for your experience”.

I can’t believe I drove 60 minutes for them, and I missed an important meeting.

It’s a shame because the vet himself had many complements on Facebook groups and such but the team around him is also important and needs an upgrade. There are many other great and clean places out there, save your time and money.
Dr. Werber and his team is always the best and so kind and caring towards my dog Kiwi. I've known Dr. Werber over 25 years. He's never let us down. 🙏🏻🙏🏻 …

Terrible service, seems like they don’t care about the health of your pets and definitely about the customer. Very disappointed with this place every time after putting me on hold for 10 minutes ROSE comes on the phone after I tell her my concern she tells me she will call back that never happens when I call back in few days she says you didn’t talk with me and I call you back and she hangs up the phone.
Very unprofessional!!!!!

I must say I never had such a personal and caring Vet experience before Nitzan Yehezkeli was following up calling numerous times to check on our Doberman during the weekend and was in contact with us  within an hour of our message that I've never experienced in years and years of having pets and visiting many
veterinary places.I highly recommend if you want your pet to have personal care and as important being updated and able to communicate with your vet.

I’ve been coming to Dr Jeff Werber here at Valuvet for two and half years. Not only is he professional, personable, attentive, EXPERIENCED… the prices he and ValuVet charge definitely live up to their name. Value. He’s an excellent vet but doesn’t gouge you on prices. They’re truly competitive to prices you’d pay if you were in say a small, less desirable market and yet he services the Westside.

My dog Blue and I are very satisfied. And the new addition to our home, a kitten, had a great appointment w us today too.

Thanks Dr jeff for your great service!

I had a very stressful situation with my dog and didn’t know where to turn after being overwhelmed by emergency vet costs. That’s when I found Value Vet ! and Dr. Nitzan, who was truly a lifesaver. He was kind, professional, and took the time to explain everything clearly. He even went out of his way to care for my dog when I couldn’t be there. The clinic felt welcoming, the prices were fair, and I never felt pressured. I’m so grateful and wouldn’t trust anyone else with my pet.
Awesome service! Super fast!  And the best part?  It was easy on the wallet!  Getting my pet's travel health certificate was a lifesaver (those things are usually a fortune in LA).

Dr Werber saved our dog. He and his team spoke to us practically and made us realize that we only needed to take one step at a time. Take the cancer out, then talk about next steps. He has a very practical approach that made us feel comfortable leaving our dog in his hands.

Over two years later and we still get asked if our 10-year-old dog is a puppy. We wouldn't have him without Dr Werber.
Dr. Werber is the best & worth the wait!

5+ Stars!
We recently booked an appointment at Value Vet in West LA after being away from the area. Dr. Werber had previously provided excellent care for our other dogs. During our visit to LA, we sought Dr. Werber's help with our 17-year-old Puggle, who was suddenly experiencing discomfort and breathing issues. The staff was prompt and accommodating, ensuring we were seen quickly. Dr. Werber was skilled and thorough in diagnosing the issue, offering effective treatment to stabilize our dog. He also provided clear and thoughtful options for next steps and followed up when we had additional questions. The entire staff was supportive and attentive throughout the visit. We truly appreciated the care and professionalism. Thank you!

Hector is the best. He is a great technician and really cares for the well-being of the patients. He is helpful with explaining the procedures and treatments that my dog Luna received. I always feel safe leaving Luna in Value Vets hands.
It is the best veterinary office in the entire city of LA! Hector takes care of patients like they were his own!

I understand they are a busy clinic, but for these last few appointments we’ve scheduled they have been 90+ minutes late in rooming us. I would rather they schedule me later than cram me into a day where I have to sit in a waiting room for this long.
The staff works hard and Dr. Werber is great. They get very busy and the waiting area can get a little crowded. Street parking so plan ahead.
It was planned to microchip my dog while he was under for neutering but they never did it. I called and they didn’t even apologize.
